0_wide_and_sparse.playbook: moderate-tempo expansion to medium-production planets, long reach

1_close_quarters_orbital.playbook: compact orbit-aware grab; closer targets, fewer but focused

2_wide_and_rich.playbook: OPENING BLITZ — fastest first launch, most launches, highest-production nearby targets

3_sparse_static_rich.playbook: patient long-arm strike to highest-production planet on the map

falsification_gate.description: At least two clusters differ by >=1 in median target production OR >=1 in median ETA-equivalent target distance.

headline_findings: Top-10 winners fire by median step 3.5 — confirms prior fingerprint observation (4.1) on a fresh extraction.
Openings target NEUTRALS overwhelmingly (84.5% median, 0% enemy median) — early aggression is the LAND GRAB, not raiding.
5 distinct targets in 6 launches: minimal double-tap. Top players spread, do not concentrate fire in the opening.

Cluster-conditional openings are real: 'wide-and-rich' boards (C2) get 10 launches and target highest-prod planets; 'sparse-static-rich' (C3) get only 6 launches at LONG distance to the single highest-prod planet.

Resolves the melccoro tension: melccoro's '+2-5%pp from early_off_until=50' makes sense only against a weak baseline where the agent would fire wastefully. Top-10 winners do NOT delay; they fire CORRECTLY.
downstream_uses: Feeds Experiment Option 1 (map-type-conditional opening book) — the four per-cluster playbooks above are the templates.

Direct opening-book first move: classify board into cluster, then launch from the home planet at the cluster's median target distance to its highest-production reachable planet, using the median ships-sent count.
